body_lead: Telangana unveils BuildNow: AI-powered new building, layout online approval system The usage of Artificial Intelligence to respond to user inquiries is another element that makes it easy to use By - Sistla Dakshina Murthy |Representational Image. Hyderabad: To further cut down on the time required for the application process, the Telangana Government is going to switch to a more straightforward and effective building permit system than TG-bPASS (Telangana Building Permit Approval and Self-Certification System) from February 1, 2025.
